summary: This is a .dockerignore file that tells Docker which files and directories to exclude when building a container image. It's similar to .gitignore but for Docker—anything listed here won't be copied into the container, keeping the image smaller and faster to build. The file excludes common development artifacts, IDE settings, dependencies, and configuration files that aren't needed in production.

explanations.7: The **/ pattern means 'match this folder name at any depth in the directory tree', so **/.classpath matches .classpath files no matter how deeply nested they are.
explanations.8: This comment with //highlight-next-line is a marker for documentation or tutorials to draw attention to the line that follows.
explanations.27: The exclamation mark reverses the previous exclusion rule—this tells Docker to NOT ignore composer.json files, even though a previous pattern might have excluded them.
explanations.30: This excludes Dockerfile and any similar files (like Dockerfile.prod), using the * wildcard to match variations.
